explication: Cursor2API is a Go HTTP service that adapts Cursor Web to an OpenAI-compatible chat API. The main workflow is client request → authenticated chat handler → Cursor request/protocol preparation → Cursor Web → parsed assistant events → API response; model listing, health checks, documentation, streaming, thinking variants, and tool calls are additional product capabilities. The excerpts establish routing, configuration, authentication, and portions of the protocol and JavaScript runtime; some internal calls and response paths are documented or implied but not visible, so those links are marked unverified.
